item.text:
{
  "schema_version": "formalization-faithfulness-1",
  "role": "blind-translation",
  "dossier_sha256": "19d6d4c66a055c16434af0e59f125f93de57bcfd5c3cfd4d63c8b38bf8004174",
  "dependency_coverage": [
    {
      "id": "D001",
      "name": "LocalDef001",
      "meaning": "The real matrix has a basis of real eigenvectors indexed by ι, with a real eigenvalue assigned to each basis vector.",
      "effect_on_target": "Assumes diagonalizability over the reals; it does not require distinct eigenvalues.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D002",
      "name": "LocalDef002",
      "meaning": "Every spatial slice of q is interval integrable, every temporal slice of flux(q) is interval integrable, and for every real a,b,s,t, the spatial integral at t minus that at s equals the temporal integral from s to t of flux(q(a,τ)) minus flux(q(b,τ)).",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires an integral conservation identity on all real space and time intervals for flux(v)=Av, together with explicit slice integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D003",
      "name": "LocalDef003",
      "meaning": "Forms the finite sum over basis indices of traveling scalar step profiles multiplied by their basis vectors. Each profile uses the corresponding basis coordinates of the three given states and travels at its assigned eigenvalue.",
      "effect_on_target": "Specifies the solution explicitly; the solution is not an independent existentially quantified function.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D004",
      "name": "LocalDef004",
      "meaning": "Returns the left state when its real argument is negative, the right state when positive, and the designated origin value when zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines both the vector initial data and the scalar coordinate profiles, including their exact values at discontinuities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D005",
      "name": "LocalDef005",
      "meaning": "Multiplies a fixed vector by the scalar traveling profile evaluated at x and t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Converts each scalar characteristic profile into a vector contribution.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D006",
      "name": "LocalDef006",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a profile at x minus speed times t.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the propagation sign and characteristic coordinate x−λt for every real x,t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D007",
      "name": "Algebra.id",
      "meaning": "The algebra structure of a commutative semiring over itself, using the identity algebra map and multiplication as scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Real scalar action on real coordinates is ordinary multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D008",
      "name": "Algebra.toSMul",
      "meaning": "Extracts the scalar action from an algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the real scalar multiplication used pointwise on vectors.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D009",
      "name": "And",
      "meaning": "Logical conjunction.",
      "effect_on_target": "All eigenvector, conservation, initial-value, and scaling assertions must hold simultaneously for the same witnesses.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D010",
      "name": "CommSemiring.toSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring structure of a commutative semiring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real arithmetic for algebra and module constructions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D011",
      "name": "DFunLike.coe",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying dependent function of a function-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Interprets a basis applied to p as its p-th vector.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D012",
      "name": "DivInvMonoid.toDiv",
      "meaning": "Extracts the division operation from a division-with-inverse monoid.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies real division in x/t.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D013",
      "name": "Eq",
      "meaning": "Equality of two objects of the same type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector equalities are exact equalities of functions, hence coordinatewise equalities, not merely almost-everywhere equalities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D014",
      "name": "Exists",
      "meaning": "Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.",
      "effect_on_target": "Chooses eigenvalues and then a basis after the matrix hypothesis and all three states have been supplied.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D015",
      "name": "Fintype",
      "meaning": "A finite type equipped with an exhaustive finite enumeration.",
      "effect_on_target": "Restricts ι to a finite index type and permits finite sums; nonemptiness is not required.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D016",
      "name": "Function.hasSMul",
      "meaning": "Lifts a scalar action to functions pointwise.",
      "effect_on_target": "For vectors, (c v)(i)=c v(i).",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D017",
      "name": "HDiv.hDiv",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected division operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Evaluates the real ratio x/t in the scaling conclusion.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D018",
      "name": "HSMul.hSMul",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected scalar multiplication operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Expresses eigenvalue multiplication and scalar-weighted basis contributions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D019",
      "name": "InnerProductSpace.toNormedSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the normed vector space structure of an inner product space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the usual real normed scalar structure; it imposes no orthogonality requirement on the eigenbasis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D020",
      "name": "LT.lt",
      "meaning": "Applies a strict order relation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Tests positivity of t and the signs of profile arguments using the real strict order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D021",
      "name": "Matrix",
      "meaning": "A function from a row index and a column index to an entry.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coefficient is an arbitrary real square matrix A:ι×ι→ℝ subject to the diagonalizability hypothesis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D022",
      "name": "Matrix.mulVec",
      "meaning": "Matrix-vector multiplication by taking each row's dot product with the vector: (Av)(i)=Σ_j A(i,j)v(j).",
      "effect_on_target": "Defines both the eigenvector equation and the linear flux v↦Av.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D023",
      "name": "Module.Basis",
      "meaning": "An indexed linear basis of a module, giving unique finite linear expansions.",
      "effect_on_target": "The eigenvectors span ℝ^ι and are linearly independent; they are not just an arbitrary eigenvector family.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D024",
      "name": "Module.Basis.instFunLike",
      "meaning": "Evaluates a basis at an index by mapping the corresponding unit coordinate vector back through its coordinate equivalence.",
      "effect_on_target": "Identifies b_p as the actual vector associated with the p-th basis coordinate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D025",
      "name": "NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets the associativity requirement while retaining the ring operations and commutativity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real operations used in matrix multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D026",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity from the supplied ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides an underlying arithmetic interface without changing real multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D027",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains addition, multiplication, distributivity, and zero laws while forgetting additive inverses as structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the arithmetic structure required by matrix-vector multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D028",
      "name": "NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying nonunital commutative ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Connects the real normed structure to the unchanged ring operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D029",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing",
      "meaning": "Forgets multiplicative commutativity while preserving the seminormed ring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the standard real seminormed additive structure.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D030",
      "name": "NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the norm, additive group, and pseudometric of a seminormed ring.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the real additive and metric structure for normed spaces.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D031",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains normed commutative ring operations while omitting the unit from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies underlying real ring operations for the matrix flux.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D032",
      "name": "NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same operations and norm.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the usual real topology and arithmetic in scalar structures.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D033",
      "name": "NormedSpace.toModule",
      "meaning": "Extracts the module structure from a normed vector space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real linear structure for the basis.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D034",
      "name": "OfNat.ofNat",
      "meaning": "Interprets a natural-number literal in the selected type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The displayed 0 and 1 are real constants.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D035",
      "name": "One.toOfNat1",
      "meaning": "Interprets the literal 1 using the type's multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scaling comparison evaluates the same solution at real time 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D036",
      "name": "Pi.Function.module",
      "meaning": "The pointwise module structure on a function space.",
      "effect_on_target": "The state space ℝ^ι uses coordinatewise linear operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D037",
      "name": "Pi.addCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The pointwise additive commutative monoid structure on dependent functions.",
      "effect_on_target": "Vector sums and zero are coordinatewise.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D038",
      "name": "Pi.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The finite product normed additive group structure on functions into normed additive groups.",
      "effect_on_target": "Equips ℝ^ι with its standard finite product norm and topology for vector integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D039",
      "name": "Pi.normedSpace",
      "meaning": "The normed vector space structure on a finite product, with pointwise scalar action.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes ℝ^ι the real normed space in the integral conservation predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D040",
      "name": "RCLike.toInnerProductSpaceReal",
      "meaning": "Views an RCLike field as a real inner product space using its real inner product and normed algebra structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "At ℝ, supplies the usual real scalar normed space; no inner product appears in the asserted solution properties.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D041",
      "name": "Real",
      "meaning": "The real number type.",
      "effect_on_target": "Matrix entries, vector coordinates, eigenvalues, space, time, and integration endpoints are real.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D042",
      "name": "Real.instAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "The additive commutative monoid structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies ordinary real addition and zero for the state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D043",
      "name": "Real.instCommSemiring",
      "meaning": "The commutative semiring structure on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports real self-algebra and scalar multiplication.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D044",
      "name": "Real.instDivInvMonoid",
      "meaning": "Real multiplication, inverse, and division, with division defined by multiplication by the inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Gives the ordinary quotient x/t whenever t>0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D045",
      "name": "Real.instLT",
      "meaning": "The strict order on the reals.",
      "effect_on_target": "Determines positive time and left, right, and zero profile branches.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D046",
      "name": "Real.instOne",
      "meaning": "The real multiplicative identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the reference time as 1.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D047",
      "name": "Real.instRCLike",
      "meaning": "The reals as an RCLike field, with identity real-part map, zero imaginary-part map, and their usual complete normed field structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies standard real normed scalar structures without introducing complex-valued states or eigenvalues.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D048",
      "name": "Real.instZero",
      "meaning": "The real additive identity.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes initial time, the profile's dividing point, and the positivity threshold as 0.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D049",
      "name": "Real.normedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "The real additive group with its usual absolute-value norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the coordinate norms underlying vector integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D050",
      "name": "Real.normedCommRing",
      "meaning": "The usual real commutative ring with its norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Ensures the algebraic and analytic constructions use compatible real operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D051",
      "name": "Real.normedField",
      "meaning": "The usual real field with its absolute-value norm, including totalized inverse with inverse of zero equal to zero.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar field for normed spaces; the asserted scaling uses only nonzero positive denominators.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D052",
      "name": "Real.semiring",
      "meaning": "The real semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the scalar arithmetic required by the basis and module types.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D053",
      "name": "SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains seminormed commutative ring operations while omitting the unit from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves the real additive normed structure used by the module instances.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D054",
      "name": "Zero.toOfNat0",
      "meaning": "Interprets the literal 0 using the type's zero element.",
      "effect_on_target": "The time and order thresholds written 0 are the real zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D055",
      "name": "instHDiv",
      "meaning": "Uses a homogeneous division operation as a heterogeneous division interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "The quotient in the conclusion is real division with real output.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D056",
      "name": "instHSMul",
      "meaning": "Uses a scalar action as the scalar-multiplication interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Applies real scalars to vectors without changing the vector type.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D057",
      "name": "AddGroup.toSubNegMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts subtraction and negation structure from an additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports vector subtraction in the conservation identity.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D058",
      "name": "CommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing",
      "meaning": "Retains commutative ring operations while omitting the unit from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides ordinary real ring operations within dependency definitions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D059",
      "name": "DFinsupp.instEquivLikeLinearEquiv",
      "meaning": "Treats a semilinear equivalence as an equivalence-like map with an underlying function and inverse.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows the basis coordinate equivalence to be applied to each given state.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D060",
      "name": "EquivLike.toFunLike",
      "meaning": "Extracts the underlying function of an equivalence-like object.",
      "effect_on_target": "Evaluates basis coordinates as scalar-valued functions of the index.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D061",
      "name": "Finite.of_fintype",
      "meaning": "A type with a finite enumeration is finite.",
      "effect_on_target": "Justifies representing all basis coordinates as unrestricted functions on ι.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D062",
      "name": "Finset.sum",
      "meaning": "The additive sum of a function over a finite set.",
      "effect_on_target": "Combines the finitely many traveling vector contributions; an empty sum is zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D063",
      "name": "Finset.univ",
      "meaning": "The finite set containing every element of a Fintype.",
      "effect_on_target": "The solution sum includes every basis index exactly once.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D064",
      "name": "HSub.hSub",
      "meaning": "Applies the selected subtraction operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Forms differences of vector integrals, endpoint fluxes, and real characteristic coordinates.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D065",
      "name": "IntervalIntegrable",
      "meaning": "Integrability on both half-open intervals (a,b] and (b,a] with respect to the given measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Requires genuine integrability on every finite spatial interval and every finite temporal flux interval, regardless of endpoint order.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D066",
      "name": "LinearEquiv",
      "meaning": "An invertible semilinear map with respect to mutually inverse scalar homomorphisms; for identity scalar maps it is a linear isomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "The basis coordinate map is a real linear isomorphism, so its coordinates determine the original vector uniquely.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D067",
      "name": "MeasureTheory.MeasureSpace.volume",
      "meaning": "Extracts the distinguished measure of a measure space.",
      "effect_on_target": "All integrability and integral assertions use the designated volume measure on ℝ.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D068",
      "name": "Module.Basis.equivFun",
      "meaning": "Composes the basis representation map with the identification of finitely supported coordinates and all coordinate functions on a finite index type.",
      "effect_on_target": "The profile coefficients are coordinates relative to the chosen eigenbasis, not the original components of the states.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D069",
      "name": "NonAssocSemiring.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Extracts the nonunital nonassociative semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Preserves addition and multiplication in the algebraic dependencies.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D070",
      "name": "NonUnitalNonAssocSemiring.toAddCommMonoid",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive commutative monoid of a semiring structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies addition and zero for finite sums.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D071",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "A commutative additive group with a compatible norm and metric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the additive and analytic setting for the vector-valued integrals.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D072",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toNormedAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Retains the normed additive group while forgetting commutativity as structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides inherited subtraction and norm interfaces for integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D073",
      "name": "NormedAddCommGroup.toSeminormedAddCommGroup",
      "meaning": "Views a normed additive commutative group as seminormed, preserving its norm, operations, and pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the topology and scalar-space interfaces used in the conservation predicate.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D074",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toAddGroup",
      "meaning": "Extracts the additive group from a normed additive group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies subtraction of vector integrals and fluxes.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D075",
      "name": "NormedAddGroup.toENormedAddMonoid",
      "meaning": "Equips a normed additive group with its compatible extended nonnegative norm and additive monoid structure.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the norm interface for interval integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D076",
      "name": "NormedSpace",
      "meaning": "A module over a normed field whose scalar action satisfies the norm bound.",
      "effect_on_target": "Allows real vector-valued integration in the state space.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D077",
      "name": "PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the uniform structure induced by a pseudometric.",
      "effect_on_target": "Contributes the norm-induced topology used for vector integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D078",
      "name": "Real.commRing",
      "meaning": "The reals with their ordinary addition, multiplication, negation, subtraction, zero, and one.",
      "effect_on_target": "Fixes the standard arithmetic used throughout the construction.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D079",
      "name": "Real.decidableLT",
      "meaning": "A decision procedure in Lean's logical sense for each real strict comparison.",
      "effect_on_target": "Makes the step-profile conditional well-defined without adding a hypothesis about its arguments.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D080",
      "name": "Real.measureSpace",
      "meaning": "The standard measure-space instance on the reals, whose volume is Lebesgue measure.",
      "effect_on_target": "The conservation law uses Lebesgue interval integrability and integration.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D081",
      "name": "RingHom.id",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism.",
      "effect_on_target": "The coordinate equivalence is linear over the same real field, with no scalar twisting.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D082",
      "name": "RingHomInvPair.ids",
      "meaning": "The identity ring homomorphism is inverse to itself.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supplies the inverse scalar-map compatibility for ordinary real linear equivalences.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D083",
      "name": "SeminormedAddCommGroup.toPseudoMetricSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the pseudometric of a seminormed additive commutative group.",
      "effect_on_target": "Provides the metric-derived topology needed for integrability.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D084",
      "name": "Semiring.toModule",
      "meaning": "A semiring acts on itself as a module by multiplication.",
      "effect_on_target": "The scalar coordinate space uses ordinary real multiplication as scalar action.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D085",
      "name": "Semiring.toNonAssocSemiring",
      "meaning": "Retains the semiring operations while omitting associativity from the interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Supports the identity ring homomorphism and other algebraic dependencies without changing operations.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D086",
      "name": "SubNegMonoid.toSub",
      "meaning": "Extracts the subtraction operation.",
      "effect_on_target": "Selects ordinary vector subtraction in the integral identities.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D087",
      "name": "UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace",
      "meaning": "Extracts the topology associated with a uniform space.",
      "effect_on_target": "Integrability uses the topology inherited from the state-space norm.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D088",
      "name": "instHSub",
      "meaning": "Uses homogeneous subtraction as the heterogeneous subtraction interface.",
      "effect_on_target": "Subtraction preserves the real or vector type in the displayed expressions.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D089",
      "name": "intervalIntegral",
      "meaning": "The integral over (a,b] minus the integral over (b,a], using restricted measures and vector-valued integration.",
      "effect_on_target": "All displayed interval integrals are oriented; reversing endpoints changes their sign, and equal endpoints give zero.",
      "status": "understood"
    },
    {
      "id": "D090",
      "name": "ite",
      "meaning": "Returns its first branch when the condition holds and its second branch otherwise.",
